repository_discipline.rationale: Contract-first owner-layer config-first backend isolation cold-path asset access and near-risk validation govern this unit.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: FADATrainer owns optimizer order, the collector retains same-state trajectory and Oracle-shadow ownership, and the checkpoint gateway owns persistence.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The formal source route exposes one alternating schedule and removes the split caller choice instead of adding a new runtime interface.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Workflow and config select the existing trainer owner; no simulator dependency or model-state transfer enters training code.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Each iteration completes IDM updates then a temporary fixed-IDM Planner pass before one weight publication; existing exact-snapshot shadow restoration is preserved.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The plan reuses the existing alternating trainer, collection transaction, env factory, checkpoint gateway, and diagnostics rather than adding a parallel framework.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Offline RED/GREEN and static checks do not claim server-native stability or policy quality.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: Tests cover parameter deltas, temporary freeze restoration, split-route rejection, student publication order, role provenance, persistence, and absence of action transformation before affected suites and static checks.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Trajectory and Oracle-shadow future/action pairs retain named roles, shapes, dtypes, finite checks, and raw action-scale identity.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: IDM updates finish first; Planner updates pass gradients through an IDM whose parameter gradients and optimizer step are disabled only for that pass.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Schema-5 continues to own paired optimizer and schedule identity; old inference schemas remain outside training resume.

residual_risks.description: Offline isolation tests cannot prove the remote MuJoCo SIGSEGV is eliminated or that the trained policy converges.
residual_risks.disposition: Require one bounded server runtime audit after local completion and separate long-training authority.

residual_risks.description: Independent agent review is unavailable because current coordination instructions prohibit delegation.
residual_risks.disposition: Perform a fresh validated final-gate self-review and report the independence gap.
